item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator instruction (authenticated inbox message, verbatim): "Implement `safe_extract.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Repository: quality-safe-extract. Read SPEC.md first; it is the authority for the API, errors and boundary cases. Keep the existing public API unchanged. Extend test_safe_extract.py (or add a focused test module) to cover every error and boundary case in SPEC.md. Use only the Python standard library. This is security-sensitive archive extraction: reject path traversal, absolute paths and unsafe links as the spec requires, and never hide failures. Keep functions under 60 lines and add meaningful input validation. Commit the work on the current branch with the repository's git identity; no attribution lines.

evidence.caption: Unit suite on the final head 5010b24 (no before/after UI; a behaviour test result)

pr.body: Approach: extract() runs read-only validation over the full batch (_require_list, _validate_root, _validate_entry, _check_batch_names, _check_target_free) before any mutation; _write_file creates parents with os.makedirs and writes via open(path, 'xb'). Root rejects empty strings and any '..' component so a symlink cannot be reached through a '..' spelling. Key files: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py. Checks: python3 -B -m unittest test_safe_extract -> 39 OK on 5010b24. Review: review-1 passed 705b662 (whole change); review-2 and review-3 failed 705b662 (empty root, 'link/..' bypass, untested validation I/O error); fixed in 5010b24; review-delta passed 705b662..5010b24. Advisory follow-ups left open: '..' in root is stricter than SPEC (e.g. 'data/../out' is refused); case-only and Unicode-normalised collisions within a batch are not detected; I/O failures after validation may leave partial directories (SPEC puts rollback out of scope); assert density is light. Assumptions: entries must be tuples (lists are rejected); data must be bytes (bytearray and memoryview are rejected).
pr.summary: Made extract(entries, root) work per SPEC.md. Now validates the whole batch (entries, names, collisions, root, every target path incl. symlinks) before writing, writes with exclusive create, and propagates I/O errors. Before: NotImplementedError stub. Now: 39 tests cover every SPEC rule.
pr.title: feat: implement safe batch extraction of regular files

risk.why: Security-sensitive archive extraction: root validation, symlink handling and path confinement are the only defence against writes outside root. Files touched: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py. Behaviour changes from a stub to the full API; tests only in the test file. Reviewers confirmed the rule set; two blocking root bugs were found and fixed before pass.
